task_description.overview: Calculate the a-value representing overall seismic activity using the Gutenberg-Richter formulation.
steps: Ensure Catalog.mc and Catalog.delta_m are defined.
Call cat.estimate_a() to compute the a-value using internal properties.
Optionally, provide delta_m and mc as arguments to cat.estimate_a().

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the a-value using Gutenberg-Richter law for the given catalog: {catalog_path}. Loading the catalog, bin the magnitudes with delta_m={delta_m} and set the completeness magnitude to {mc}, and then estimate the a-value using `cat.estimate_a()`. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the a-value data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
